[RichardL] Fixed. You were missing |-|-| after the table header.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] @RichardL: ok I see now yes user error thank you sorry.
[WatchNerd] From my experience I would steer clear of China Cheapo's with too much going on & ones with metal bracelets.
It's highly unlikely the case is stainless steel also. This review thinks it's resin & one of the comments said it as well.
Some of the comments -
I bought one of these a few months ago, in black. Absolutely the worst watch I've ever bought - cheap, nasty finish, impossible to set the time and has the nastiest bracelet ever, it will strip your wrist of hair in seconds. Avoid at all costs, even if it's free!
case is plastic, no steel as seller wrote on Aliex. Clasp is a bit tricky to open it completely. But this watch looks nice for its price. ;-)
Bought 1 last July. Light stopped working a week ago. Do these lights last not long?
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] Iogged back in to comment.
I forgot to put it in post but I watched couple reviews for this before posting, and they said they suspect the case isn't stainless steel like the bracelet, but the case is made from zinc alloy, which is a metal. I heard zinc alloy is a softer metal than stainless steel, so it could be mistaken as plastic.
I heard cheap Casio's are plastic but I thought this was the difference for alixepress "casio copies" they have metal case instead of plastic which is common in casio's.
ofc I could be wrong. but aliexpress worked this way when I used to shop regularly, they hold the money until certain few day period after receiving delivery (do it straight away I think like only 2 or 3 day), so if you prove it's not as described, you can mark item as not described and request refund. sometimes needs to be returned but once successful you get your money back.
[movieman] Any recommendations for a non plastic watch?
Keen to have a metal watch, alarm clock, and backlight.
But actually metal.
Preferably on the budget end, and not too heavy.
[WatchNerd] Just One More Watch reviewed the metal Skmei 1456. I prefer the plastic Skmei 1628.
